evals.name: map-indoor-filter
evals.prompt: Add a filter option so users can show only indoor AEDs on the map (OSM tag indoor=yes).
assertions: Adds no new HTTP request / fetch / axios call
Filters AEDs already in memory (source filter on aedAll + same rule for aedByStatus), no re-download
Extends the existing AedOverlayStrategy / AedStatusOverlayStrategy instead of a new overlay architecture
New strings added to all 8 locale files (app + web, de/fr/it/en)

evals.name: map-heatmap-low-zoom
evals.prompt: At low zoom levels (whole Switzerland view) show a heatmap of AED density instead of the cluster bubbles, switch to the normal clusters/markers when zooming in.
assertions: Adds no new source; heatmap layer uses the existing AED source
Adds no new HTTP request / fetch / axios call
Zoom switching is done with layer minzoom/maxzoom or zoom expressions, not a JS zoom listener
Heatmap colours come from existing COLORS constants / design palette, not new ad-hoc hex values

evals.name: map-highlight-near-user
evals.prompt: When GPS is active, highlight the AEDs within 500 m of the user's location on the map so you can spot the closest ones quickly.
assertions: Adds no new HTTP request (uses already-loaded source data)
Highlights via setFeatureState / FEATURE_STATE, not a new copied source
Guards against recomputing on every GPS tick (e.g. only when position moved / memoized)
Clears the highlight when GPS is turned off or the overlay changes
